comments.author: Battousai
comments.body:
I agree with Oleh with everything. But the amusing thing is that deck is even more broken than you spoke. The point is... Its not just that you dont need to be good at controling ship, positioning, tactics. Just enter deck and overpower your opponent. In 1x1 against non turtles the deckers are kinda protected against pillage orders/melee items, since you can start the deck right away. Also immune to disorder, to escaping, training bombs... Whatever. As soon the melee is on, its deck most of the time. Also, deckers can force whole teams to deck, avoiding escapes, since they need to melee only admiral. So even if you are in a turtle but your fleet admiral isnt, deck will be on. I've heard that pvp deck battles were nerfed recently in japanese server to require agreement for both captains. Maybe they've being complaining a lot there.

Just a side note, NOTC has some new veteran players from other server. This server is starting to get its own veterans only now I guess.
